title: Pricing Assist Superhost Adjustment by Host Tier — Roamhaven Listings
content:
# Pricing Assist Superhost Adjustment by Host Tier

*Host terms clause for Roamhaven Listings, read from the host's Host Accounts record.*

**Clause.** The Superhost adjustment is a Pricing Assist adjustment, a fraction of the all-in night, worked out on the day of the request from the tier of the host account the listing belongs to, as its Host Accounts record shows it. When the host account's tier is Superhost, the Superhost adjustment is **0.02**; when it is Starter Host, it is **-0.02**, a reduction; for any other tier there is none.

| Host account tier | Superhost adjustment |
|---|---|
| Superhost | 0.02 |
| Starter Host | -0.02 (a reduction) |
| Standard Host | none |
| Professional Host | none |
| Professional Host Plus | none |
| Enterprise Partner | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical all-in night of $200.00)

A Superhost adjustment of 0.02 is worth $4.00 of a $200.00 all-in night; a Starter Host reduction of 0.02 is worth $4.00 off.
